videos.title: The Untaught Stickhandling Mechanics You Need To Know
videos.summary_source_text:
The Untaught Stickhandling Mechanics You Need To Know Welcome to Precise Puck Control.

There’s a reason we call this puck control and not just stickhandling.

Stickhandling usually refers to isolated mechanics like moving the puck around cones or in drills disconnected and from real gameplay. Puck control, in our context, is different. It’s the conscious ability to move the puck exactly where you want, at the speed you want, while your skating, shooting, and deception mechanics are fully integrated.

At Train 2.0, we teach it as part of a complete movement system.

The truth: isolated stickhandling doesn’t transfer to games. You might develop quick hands. You might look smooth in drills. But without integrating footwork, balance, posture, and skating mechanics, you’ll be missing that puck on a string look in-game.

We’ve all seen players with “great hands” who somehow struggle in games. That disconnect happens when puck skills are trained without mechanical awareness or integration. Repeating the same patterns around cones without adjusting mechanics can actually reinforce bad habits instead of building elite control.

Our goal with this system is to give you a language for puck control: a mechanical framework you can understand, feel, and adjust. When you combine awareness with deliberate repetition, you build mastery.

Inside this course, you’ll learn:

1) How elite NHL players integrate skating, handling, and deception.

2) What mechanical adjustments create real control at top speed.

3) How to systematically close the gaps in your own puck control.

4) How to create more options in more situations during games.

👉  Drills, breakdowns, progressions, and full mechanics playbook (100’s of videos) all available in Train 2.0+. Welcome to Precise Puck Control.

videos.title: Sleep on This Side Tonight — Your Stomach Will Thank You | Dr. Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
Sleep on This Side Tonight — Your Stomach Will Thank You | Dr. Mandell If you wake up with reflux, bloating, heaviness, abdominal pressure, or throat irritation, your sleeping position may be playing a bigger role than you realize. In this video, I explain why sleeping on your left side may help keep stomach acid lower, support more comfortable digestion, encourage natural movement through the digestive tract, and reduce pressure that can contribute to nighttime discomfort. I’ll also show you how anatomy, gravity, circulation, and body position interact while you sleep, and why such a simple change may help you wake up feeling lighter and more refreshed. Tonight, try starting on your left side, keep your neck and spine supported, place a pillow between your knees if needed, and pay attention to how you feel in the morning. Small changes in how you sleep can sometimes make a noticeable difference in how your body feels overnight and the next day.

videos.summary_source_text:
Grok 5 Explained: Elon Musk’s 6 TRILLION Parameter AI Explained https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
Elon Musk says Grok 5 could become the smartest AI in the world — with a rumored 6–10 TRILLION parameters, massive context window, and potentially even Tesla driving video in its training data.

But there’s a problem.

Grok 5 has already missed multiple expected release windows, several of its biggest specifications remain unconfirmed, and the latest Grok model suggests that simply making an AI dramatically bigger may not be enough to beat GPT-5.6, Claude Opus 5, or Google Gemini.

In this video, we separate what’s actually confirmed about Grok 5 from the leaks, Musk’s claims, and speculation.

We break down:

• Grok 5’s rumored 6–10 trillion parameters
• Elon Musk’s claim that Grok 5 has a chance of achieving AGI
• The Tesla FSD video-training rumor
• Grok’s controversial X training data
• What Grok 4.6 tells us about Grok 5
• Grok 5 vs GPT-5.6 Sol, Claude Opus 5, and Gemini
• Expected pricing and API access
• Coding, research, legal, and enterprise use cases
• Copyright and training-data concerns
• Why raw model size may not translate into better AI
• When Grok 5 could actually launch

Is Grok 5 about to become the most powerful AI model ever built — or is Elon Musk making an enormous bet on an AI scaling strategy the rest of the industry is already moving beyond?

Watch until the end for what’s confirmed, what’s still unverified, and what will actually prove whether Grok 5 lives up to the hype.

Most power skating coaches teach arm swing based on what they see in sprinters, and on the surface it makes complete sense. videos.title: Just 2 cloves of garlic! And your orchid will bloom nonstop!
videos.summary_source_text:
Just 2 cloves of garlic! And your orchid will bloom nonstop! Just 2 cloves of garlic! And your orchid will bloom nonstop!

Two cloves of garlic and a glass of water — that's the whole recipe. Garlic water is one of the oldest tricks orchid growers use, and it does three jobs at once: it disinfects the roots, cleans and protects the leaves, and feeds the plant without any chemistry.

In this video I show the whole process from start to finish:

00:00  Why fresh garlic, and never dried or powdered
00:45  Chopping it fine so the compounds pass into the water
01:41  Making the infusion — water, lid, a few hours
02:25  Straining it through a sieve and cheesecloth
02:56  Wiping the leaves with a cotton pad, top and underside
03:53  Watering the substrate with what's left

The result is firm glossy leaves, living roots that don't rot, and an orchid that blooms far more willingly.

No fertilizers, no chemicals, no special equipment. Garlic, water, a cotton pad.

videos.title: The Healing Power of Lemon — Fight Inflammation and Protect Your Body | Dr. Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
The Healing Power of Lemon — Fight Inflammation and Protect Your Body | Dr. Mandell Discover the healing power of lemon and what this simple citrus fruit may be doing inside your body. Lemons provide vitamin C, citric acid, flavonoids, limonoids, and other powerful plant compounds that have been studied for their antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. In this video, Dr. Alan Mandell explains how lemon water can support hydration, digestion, healthy circulation, immune function, collagen production, and your body's natural defenses against oxidative stress. You'll also discover why citrate from lemon is especially interesting for kidney health and calcium stone prevention, how citrus compounds may influence inflammatory pathways, and why replacing sugary drinks with refreshing lemon water can be a simple addition to a healthier lifestyle. Lemon is not a cure for disease, but research continues to uncover fascinating ways its nutrients and bioactive compounds may support the body's normal protective and metabolic processes. Make this valuable information part of your healthy lifestyle and please share it with your friends and family.

PubMed Research:

“Can Lemon Juice Be an Alternative to Potassium Citrate in the Treatment of Urinary Calcium Stones in Patients With Hypocitraturia?” — A randomized clinical study found that fresh lemon juice significantly increased urinary citrate, an important factor in reducing calcium stone formation.

“Features, Pharmacological Chemistry, Molecular Mechanism and Health Benefits of Lemon” — A scientific review of Citrus limon discusses its bioactive compounds and reported antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, metabolic and organ-protective properties, while noting that evidence varies by outcome and study type.

“Citrus limon (Lemon) Phenomenon” — This review describes lemon's flavonoids, phenolic compounds and other bioactive constituents and summarizes research into antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activity.

“Effects of Citrus Fruit Juices and Their Bioactive Components on Inflammation and Immunity” — This PubMed-indexed review describes how vitamin C and citrus polyphenols interact with oxidative stress, inflammatory pathways and immune function; much of the human juice evidence reviewed was from orange juice rather than lemon specifically.

“Limonoids With Anti-Inflammatory Activity: A Review” — Research examining limonoids found in citrus and related plants describes anti-inflammatory activity involving inflammatory mediators and cytokine pathways, primarily from experimental studies.

We’ve got our hands on the Gunther Werks F26, and we’re putting it up against some incredible supercars! 

The Gunther Werks F26 is based on a Porsche 993, and it’s powered by a 4-litre twin-turbo flat-six that delivers an incredible 1,067hp and 1,017Nm! This power is sent to the rear wheels only via a 6-speed manual, and its carbon-fibre body means it weighs just 1,347kg! It’s limited to just 26 units worldwide, so it costs £1,200,000! 

So, given we’ve got our hands on such a rare car, we wanted to put it up against some supercar royalty, starting with the Porsche 911 GT3 RS. 

The GT3 RS is equipped with a 4-litre NA flat-six, and this creates 525hp and 465Nm. Power is sent to the rear via a 7-speed dual-clutch, and it tips the scales at 1,450kg. 

Should the Gunther Werks defeat the GT3 RS, we’ll bring in a Huracán Performante. This comes with a 5.2-litre naturally aspirated V10, and it puts down 640hp and 600Nm. However, unlike the F26, it comes with all-wheel drive! It’s still heavier, mind, coming in at 1,482kg. 

Should the F26 beat the Huracan, we have another contender waiting in the wings… But you’ll need to keep watching to see what it is! 

The question is, do you think the Gunther Werks F26 is worth the £1.2m price tag? Let us know in the comments!

21.08.26 - RIFT Education Day RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

videos.summary_source_text:
OpenAI and Google Just Changed Cybersecurity Forever https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
OpenAI and Google just made two very different bets on the future of AI cybersecurity.

OpenAI's GPT-5.6-Cyber goes deep: a highly capable cybersecurity model designed to find, understand, and help exploit software vulnerabilities — but access is tightly restricted.

Google's Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber goes wide: a smaller, faster model built to scan huge amounts of code repeatedly through Google's CodeMender system.

Both approaches have already found real security vulnerabilities. But there's a catch: the numbers being used to compare them aren't actually comparable, and neither company has proven its model is definitively better.

In this video, we break down:

• GPT-5.6-Cyber and OpenAI's Daybreak program
• Gemini 3.5 Flash Cyber and Google CodeMender
• The real vulnerabilities these AI systems have discovered
• Why these cybersecurity models remain heavily restricted
• Why OpenAI and Google's benchmark numbers can't be directly compared
• The growing AI cybersecurity race involving Anthropic, Microsoft, DARPA and others
• What AI-powered vulnerability research means for cybersecurity

The bigger question isn't simply whether OpenAI or Google wins. It's whether the future of AI cybersecurity belongs to extremely powerful models operating under tight controls — or smaller models scanning software continuously at massive scale.

videos.summary_source_text:
Heal Neuropathy, Nerve Pain & Inflammation | Dr. Mandell Burning feet, tingling hands, numbness, stabbing pain, and electric-shock sensations can be signs that your nerves are irritated, damaged, or struggling to function normally. In this video, I share 9 powerful ways to help support neuropathy, nerve pain, and inflammation by addressing factors that can affect the health of the nerve itself. You’ll learn how stabilizing blood sugar, reducing oxidative stress and chronic inflammation, supporting mitochondrial energy production, getting adequate magnesium and important B vitamins such as B1 and B12, and nutrients including alpha-lipoic acid, CoQ10, omega-3 fatty acids, and curcumin may support healthier nerve function. I’ll also explain why regular movement, quality sleep, breathing, and stress reduction can play an important role in calming overly sensitive nerves and supporting cellular repair. Your nerves require tremendous amounts of energy to maintain normal electrical signaling, and when mitochondrial function and ATP production are impaired, nerves may become more irritable and hyperexcitable. The goal is not simply to cover up burning and tingling, but to understand and address factors that may be contributing to unhealthy nerve function. Neuropathy has many possible causes, including diabetes, vitamin deficiencies, medications, chemotherapy, nerve compression, and other medical conditions, so persistent or worsening numbness, burning, tingling, weakness, or pain should always be evaluated by a qualified healthcare professional. But is GPT-5.6 actually the smartest AI model yet — or is the biggest story hiding somewhere else?

• Up to 750 output tokens/second

20.08.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

Fansbase Confidence in Avs Front Office Improves. Drafting and Developing Remains Biggest Obstacle Colorado Avalanche front office confidence surges as fan sentiment shifts—are the Avs building another Stanley Cup contender? Chris Micieli and Zach Pearson break down The Athletic’s front office report card, revealing a leap to 9th overall, but question whether drafting and prospect development are holding the team back. With key names like Nathan MacKinnon and Cale Makar anchoring the core, the conversation spotlights fan frustrations over missed opportunities and the need for more young talent.

The hosts tackle hot-button NHL topics, including league-wide fan polls on Gary Bettman’s legacy, the impact of income taxes on free agency, and whether expanded gambling threatens hockey's integrity. From Department of Player Safety controversies to bold proposals like shorthanded goal penalties and rethinking playoff seeding, every angle gets a candid, passionate look. Are the Avalanche primed for sustained dominance, or could critical weaknesses derail their ambitions?

How Should You Skate In A Tight Circle The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

videos.title: Never Forget Someone’s Name Again — Do This When You Meet Them | Dr. Mandell
videos.summary_source_text:
Never Forget Someone’s Name Again — Do This When You Meet Them | Dr. Mandell Have you ever met someone, heard their name clearly, and then seconds later realized it was completely gone? This happens to millions of people, and it doesn’t necessarily mean you have a bad memory. Names are unusually difficult for the brain to remember because, unlike a face, voice, object, or location, a name often has very little built-in meaning or visual information for the brain to grab onto. When you first hear a name, it enters working memory, where attention is limited and easily interrupted by everything else happening during a social interaction—making eye contact, thinking about what you’re going to say, listening to the other person, and being aware of how you are coming across. If that information isn’t properly encoded, the name may disappear before it ever becomes a stable memory. In this video, I explain how attention, working memory, the prefrontal cortex, and the hippocampus work together when you meet someone, and why stress, fatigue, poor sleep, distraction, and simply having too much going on at once can make remembering names even more difficult. More importantly, I’ll show you several simple ways to make a name more memorable the moment you hear it. Repeating the name once out loud can strengthen your attention to it. Connecting the name to a visual feature gives the brain another association to retrieve later. Adding a small physical movement, deliberately focusing your attention, and creating a meaningful association can provide additional cues for encoding and recall. Timing also matters—the first few seconds after hearing a name are important, so instead of trying desperately to remember it minutes later, give it your full attention immediately. Forgetting a newly introduced person’s name from time to time is common and is different from persistent or progressive memory problems involving familiar people, places, events, or everyday functioning. The goal is to work with the way your memory naturally operates: pay attention, create associations, repeat important information, and give your brain multiple ways to retrieve it later. Try these techniques the next time someone introduces themselves and see how much easier remembering their name can become. Please share this video with your friends and family, and most importantly, make it a day!  Dr. Mandell

Elon Musk’s “Macrohard” Could Change Work Forever… If It Actually Works https://bitbiased.ai/ai-automation-services
Elon Musk’s Macrohard sounds almost impossible: an AI system designed to emulate the functions of an entire software company — potentially handling coding, customer support, spreadsheets, enterprise software and more through autonomous AI agents.

But how much of it is actually real?

In this video, I break down Elon Musk’s Macrohard AI project, the reported Tesla and xAI connection, the technology behind its computer-use agents, the money involved, and the surprisingly large gap between what has been promised and what has actually been demonstrated.

The idea is ambitious. Grok would act as the “brain,” planning complex tasks, while a Tesla-built computer-use agent would act as the “body” — watching a computer screen and operating software through the mouse and keyboard.

And unlike many AI agents that depend on integrations or APIs, the bigger vision is an AI worker capable of using software much more like a human does.

If it works, the implications could extend far beyond Tesla, xAI or Microsoft. It could affect enterprise software, SaaS pricing, customer support, software development and ultimately the way companies think about human work itself.

But there’s a major problem.

There still hasn’t been a public demonstration proving the full vision works — and reporting around the project raises questions about how quickly Musk’s ambitious plan can actually become reality.

So is Macrohard the beginning of the AI-run company?

Or is the hype moving much faster than the technology?

Watch the full breakdown before deciding.

videos.title: The Driver Comparison Test Some People WON'T Like
videos.summary_source_text:
The Driver Comparison Test Some People WON'T Like Let’s compare the Cobra OPTM X driver and Titleist GTS2 driver. In this Cobra OPTM X vs Titleist GTS2 driver review, Mark Crossfield puts two of the best golf drivers of 2026 head-to-head to compare performance, distance, forgiveness, ball speed, spin, technology and price.

The Cobra OPTM X and Titleist GTS2 both promise more speed, stability and forgiveness, but they use very different technology to achieve it, and there's also a significant difference in price. So which performs better, what are you actually getting for your money, and which one should you buy?

Mark tests both drivers using launch monitor data to compare ball speed, carry distance, spin rates and consistency, while also looking at appearance, sound, feel, adjustability and fitting options.

The Cobra OPTM X features Cobra's new POI (Product of Inertia) approach to stability alongside H.O.T. Face technology, adjustable weighting and the FutureFit33 hosel, giving golfers a huge range of fitting and shot-shape options.

The Titleist GTS2 uses Titleist's Split Mass Frame, Speed Sync face technology, adjustable weighting, improved aerodynamics and the established SureFit hosel to combine speed and stability in a driver designed to suit a wide range of golfers.
But how much difference does all of that technology actually make when both clubs are properly fitted to the same golfer?

With around £100 separating these two drivers, the comparison raises a bigger question about modern golf equipment: does spending more actually give you better performance? Or are fitting, looks, sound, feel and brand preference becoming increasingly important when choosing between modern drivers?

Mat’s about to get his hands on a Pagani Utopia Roadster! 

He’s had his hands on a Pagani in a drag race before, but he’s never had the chance to get behind the wheel of one on the open road. However, that’s about to change! 

He’s over in Modena at the Pagani factory, and he’s about to see what it’s like to drive a €3,100,000 hypercar through the Italian hills! So let’s take a closer look at the car he’ll be driving… 

From the outside, this Pagani screams power and performance. Up front there’s an absolutely huge opening in the bumper to help cool the engine, and there are vents on either side of the wide wheel arches. The headlights also have a very distinct design, which is actually inspired by classic cars and Vespas from the 1960s! There’s also the single windscreen wiper, which is synonymous with Paganis. Around the back, the Utopia Roadster has incredible presence, with the ceramic-coated quad tailpipes sitting in the centre of the rear end. There’s also a large wing with active aero. But what’s most surprising is that a car with so much power has a completely flat bottom - no aggressive-looking diffuser to be found here! 

Step inside and the Pagani is incredibly well built. Any bit of metal you see is milled aluminium, and any area not covered in metal is likely lined in leather. There are analogue dials for the driver, and a small digital screen in-between each dial to manage the infotainment system. That means that the centre console and dash are completely bereft of screens, instead including more dials and a host of physical switches! 

The Pagani Utopia Roadster is powered by a 6-litre twin-turbo V12 that delivers 864hp and 1,100Nm of torque. It’s an AMG engine that revs to 6,500RPM, and the power is delivered to the rear wheels only via a 7-speed manual gearbox. In terms of weight, it tips the scales at only 1,280kg dry.

videos.title: 19.08.26 - Ep.22 (Part 2) - The Prop Trading Revolution: Why Win Rate Means Almost Nothing
videos.summary_source_text:
19.08.26 - Ep.22 (Part 2) - The Prop Trading Revolution: Why Win Rate Means Almost Nothing In this episode, we go deeper into professional trader evaluation and explore why one of the most commonly misunderstood trading metrics — win rate — tells us far less than many traders think.

A trader can have a very high win rate and still perform poorly if their losses are large enough. Conversely, a trader with a lower win rate can produce much stronger long-term results through disciplined risk management, controlled losses and favorable risk-to-reward.

We examine the difference between win rate and expectancy, and why professional institutions focus on the overall distribution and quality of returns rather than simply counting winning trades.

From there, we explore the key metrics used by hedge funds, prop firms and professional capital managers to evaluate traders and strategies, including:

Sharpe Ratio
Sortino Ratio
Maximum Drawdown
Profit Factor
Recovery Factor
Alpha and Beta
Volatility
Correlation
Position Concentration
Risk-adjusted performance

We also look at why capital preservation sits at the center of professional trading. Making money is only one part of the equation. The more important question is whether a trader can protect capital, control drawdowns and continue performing across changing market conditions.

Position Sizing: The Science of Survival

The episode also examines why position sizing can be more important than simply predicting market direction.

Professional capital managers use structured approaches to determine how much capital should be exposed to any individual opportunity. We introduce concepts such as:

Fixed position sizing
Volatility-based position sizing
Value at Risk
Kelly Criterion
Portfolio exposure limits

The objective is simple: no single trade should be capable of causing catastrophic damage to the portfolio.

This leads to a central principle of professional capital management:

The best trader is not necessarily the trader who generates the highest returns. It may be the trader who manages risk most effectively and consistently.

From One-Time Challenges to Continuous Evaluation

We then move into the next stage of the discussion: how artificial intelligence could change the way professional traders are evaluated.

Traditional prop trading generally uses a front-loaded evaluation model. A trader completes a challenge, reaches certain objectives, and may then receive access to capital.

But professional institutions operate differently. Portfolio managers are continuously monitored. Risk exposure changes. Position limits evolve. Capital allocation can increase or decrease depending on sustained performance.

AI creates the possibility of bringing this kind of continuous evaluation into future proprietary trading infrastructure.

Instead of simply asking:

"Did this trader make money?"

AI can examine:

"How did this trader make money?"

Every trade generates data — including execution, position size, holding period, market conditions, drawdown behavior, reactions to losses, consistency, rule adherence and risk management.

Over thousands of trades, this information can create a detailed behavioral and performance profile.

Dynamic Capital Scoring

The episode concludes by introducing Dynamic Capital Scoring.

Rather than permanently assigning the same amount of capital to every trader, future systems could continuously evaluate performance and adapt capital allocation accordingly.

For example:

Higher consistency → higher score → greater potential capital access

Declining discipline → lower score → reduced allocation

This creates a more adaptive model in which capital follows demonstrated performance and disciplined risk management.

We finish this session at Dynamic Capital Scoring and will continue into Autonomous Prop Trading Infrastructure in the next part.

Key themes: win rate vs expectancy, institutional trader evaluation, Sharpe Ratio, Sortino Ratio, drawdown, profit factor, recovery factor, position sizing, capital preservation, AI-powered evaluation, continuous trader assessment and dynamic capital allocation. In this episode, we go deeper into professional trader evaluation and explore why one of the most commonly misunderstood trading metrics — win rate — tells us far less than many traders think.

A trader can have a very high win rate and still perform poorly if their losses are large enough. Conversely, a trader with a lower win rate can produce much stronger long-term results through disciplined risk management, controlled losses and favorable risk-to-reward.

We examine the difference between win rate and expectancy, and why professional institutions focus on the overall distribution and quality of returns rather than simply counting winning trades.

From there, we explore the key metrics used by hedge funds, prop firms and professional capital managers to evaluate traders and strategies, including:

Sharpe Ratio
Sortino Ratio
Maximum Drawdown
Profit Factor
Recovery Factor
Alpha and Beta
Volatility
Correlation
Position Concentration
Risk-adjusted performance

We also look at why capital preservation sits at the center of professional trading. Making money is only one part of the equation. The more important question is whether a trader can protect capital, control drawdowns and continue performing across changing market conditions.

Position Sizing: The Science of Survival

The episode also examines why position sizing can be more important than simply predicting market direction.

Professional capital managers use structured approaches to determine how much capital should be exposed to any individual opportunity. We introduce concepts such as:

Fixed position sizing
Volatility-based position sizing
Value at Risk
Kelly Criterion
Portfolio exposure limits

The objective is simple: no single trade should be capable of causing catastrophic damage to the portfolio.

This leads to a central principle of professional capital management:

The best trader is not necessarily the trader who generates the highest returns. It may be the trader who manages risk most effectively and consistently.

From One-Time Challenges to Continuous Evaluation

We then move into the next stage of the discussion: how artificial intelligence could change the way professional traders are evaluated.

Traditional prop trading generally uses a front-loaded evaluation model. A trader completes a challenge, reaches certain objectives, and may then receive access to capital.

But professional institutions operate differently. Portfolio managers are continuously monitored. Risk exposure changes. Position limits evolve. Capital allocation can increase or decrease depending on sustained performance.

AI creates the possibility of bringing this kind of continuous evaluation into future proprietary trading infrastructure.

Instead of simply asking:

"Did this trader make money?"

AI can examine:

"How did this trader make money?"

Every trade generates data — including execution, position size, holding period, market conditions, drawdown behavior, reactions to losses, consistency, rule adherence and risk management.

Over thousands of trades, this information can create a detailed behavioral and performance profile.

Dynamic Capital Scoring

The episode concludes by introducing Dynamic Capital Scoring.

Rather than permanently assigning the same amount of capital to every trader, future systems could continuously evaluate performance and adapt capital allocation accordingly.

For example:

Higher consistency → higher score → greater potential capital access

Declining discipline → lower score → reduced allocation

This creates a more adaptive model in which capital follows demonstrated performance and disciplined risk management.

We finish this session at Dynamic Capital Scoring and will continue into Autonomous Prop Trading Infrastructure in the next part.

Key themes: win rate vs expectancy, institutional trader evaluation, Sharpe Ratio, Sortino Ratio, drawdown, profit factor, recovery factor, position sizing, capital preservation, AI-powered evaluation, continuous trader assessment and dynamic capital allocation.

From Worst On Her Team To One Of California’s Top Players The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

Explore new and used car deals with Carwow: https://bit.ly/Change-Your-Car-1908

Who’s ready for a V10 showdown?! 

We’ve got Mat in the Mk4 Viper ACR, and he’s going head-to-head against Nick in the E60 M5! 

However, the Viper has a trick up its sleeve - it’s had a slight tune applied to it! But will it make much of a difference? Let’s check out the stats…

Starting with the Dodge, it’s powered by an 8.4-litre naturally aspirated V10 that usually produces 608hp and 760Nm. However, following the tune, it now produces 650hp and 800Nm! This power is sent to the rear wheels only via a 6-speed manual, and it tips the scales at 1,533kg. All-in, the car is worth around £130,000.

Then we come to the BMW. Unlike the Viper, it’s had no mods added to it, which means its 5-litre V10 produces 507hp and 520Nm, with this power being sent to the rear wheels only via a 7-speed auto gearbox. It’s also the heavier car of the two, weighing in at 1,755kg.

18.08.26 - RIFT Presentation RIFT is a modern trading platform that combines automated trading, manual trading, futures trading, and educational tools into one ecosystem.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

Whether you are completely new to trading, looking for automated solutions, interested in futures markets, or seeking to expand your financial knowledge, RIFT aims to provide a complete ecosystem where users can learn, participate, and grow.

Why Do My Legs Get Heavy Mid Shift? The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body’s own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness.
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

Designed for both beginners and experienced traders, RIFT aims to simplify access to financial markets while providing users with tools that can help them participate more efficiently.

One of the key features of RIFT is its Auto Trading Engine, which allows users to allocate capital into automated trading strategies designed to operate without the need for constant monitoring. This enables participants to remain active in the markets without spending hours each day analyzing charts or placing trades manually.

For users who prefer direct market participation, RIFT also offers Manual Trading and Futures Trading functionality. This gives traders the flexibility to execute their own strategies, manage positions, and take advantage of market opportunities in real time.

RIFT is built around a non-custodial philosophy, meaning users maintain control of their own funds rather than depositing them into a centralized company account. This approach aligns with the growing demand for greater transparency, security, and user control within the digital asset industry.

Beyond trading, RIFT focuses heavily on education. Through training sessions, community support, and ongoing learning resources, users can develop a deeper understanding of trading, risk management, market psychology, and financial technology.

The platform also incorporates modern technologies such as AI-driven infrastructure, advanced execution systems, copy trading capabilities, and future integrations designed to create a more connected and intelligent trading environment.

videos.summary_source_text:
From Beginner to All-Star, Rylie’s Transformation The Downhill Skating System is the mechanics-first approach that unlocks effortless, controlled speed on the ice without extra conditioning, pushing or “trying harder.” Inspired by the movement signatures of players like Connor McDavid, Nathan MacKinnon, Cale Makar, Quinn Hughes, and other elite NHL skaters, this system teaches you how to move on the ice with gravity, using your body's own stretch shortening cycles mixed with the most efficient footwork patterns and various skating mechanics.

Most players skate “uphill”: stiff, blocky, pushing hard, creating tension and burning energy like we were always taught in traditional powerskating. Downhill skating flips that model. By using counter rotation, proper joint angles, and natural gravitational momentum, we teach you move faster with less effort.

Inside the Downhill Skating System, players learn to:

1) Unlock the inner spring for better acceleration.
2)Use different footwork patterns to add options, deception and effortlessness. 
3)Proper joint alignment for efficiency and balance instead of creating tension with push strides.

Apply NHL-base mechanics like shin angle, Y-angle, rhythm and cadence. Generate speed using the rocker, with heel pressure and subtle weight transfers.

This system is not what players would learn in traditional, outdated power skating methods. It’s a biomechanics-based operating system designed to match your body type and natural movement patterns.

Whether you’re trying to improve the forward stride, lateral movements, deception, or posture, Downhill Skating reveals the hidden mechanics the NHL’s best rely on, and shows you how to plug them into your game step by step.

If you’re ready to skate faster with less effort, flow through transitions, and move with the smoothness of the world’s best players, the Downhill Skating System is your blueprint to faster player development.

videos.title: The Easy Way To Hit Straighter Golf Shots - Every Club
videos.summary_source_text:
The Easy Way To Hit Straighter Golf Shots - Every Club Want to learn how to hit straighter golf shots, including straight iron shots and straighter drives? This easy-to-follow golf swing drill works with every club in your bag and is one of the simplest ways to improve clubface control for more consistent ball striking and straighter golf shots.

Whether you're struggling with your driver, your irons or both, this practice drill can help you hit straighter iron shots and straighter drives without overhauling your entire golf swing.

In this golf lesson, Mark Crossfield demonstrates a practice station using nothing more than a spare golf tee to improve one of the biggest keys to better golf: clubface control.

By improving how the clubface behaves during your takeaway and follow-through, you'll find it much easier to start the ball on your intended line, reduce slices, hooks and inconsistent strikes, and build a more reliable golf swing.

The best part? This drill works with every club in the bag. Whether you're hitting driver, fairway woods, hybrids, long irons, short irons or wedges, the same principles apply to help you hit straighter golf shots more consistently.

If you're looking to improve your golf swing, hit the ball straighter, gain more consistency and lower your scores, give this drill a try and let us know in the comments how it works for you.

If you enjoyed this lesson, subscribe for more simple golf tips, golf swing drills and on-course coaching every week.

Here's what you'll learn in this lesson:

- How to improve clubface control using a simple golf tee and a practice station you can set up anywhere.
- Why your takeaway controls your golf swing long before you reach the top of the backswing.
- How to hit straighter golf shots by improving clubface awareness instead of making complicated swing changes.
- Why this drill works with every club, from driver through to your wedges.
- How to hit straighter drives and straighter iron shots without changing your entire swing.
- A simple way to practise at the driving range that gives instant feedback on your takeaway and release.

videos.title: New Audi E7X Review: 680hp for under £40k!
videos.summary_source_text:
New Audi E7X Review: 680hp for under £40k! Is the all-new Chinese Audi E7X better than the German Audi Q8?

Get 20% off Car Vertical using code Carwow: https://www.carvertical.com/carwow

Mat’s got his hands on the all-new Audi E7X. 

However, this is no ordinary Audi! It’s been built exclusively for the Chinese market, so we won’t see it on sale in the UK, Europe or the USA! But why is that?

Audi is well aware that those looking to purchase a car in China are much more likely to buy something that is home-grown, rather than a German export. As a result, the E7X is a joint venture between Audi and SAIC, with Audi’s traditional four-ring logo dropped in favour of capitalised AUDI lettering instead. 

The question is, what else has changed? Let’s take a closer look… 

Starting with the design, although the size is relatively similar to an Audi Q8, there is almost nothing else that distinguishes it as an Audi. Whereas all German manufacturers' cars will follow some of the same design cues, if you were to remove the AUDI badging from the front and rear, you’d be hard-pressed to know what the brand was! Still, up front it looks modern and futuristic, with thin headlights and a wraparound loop design that features Matrix LED lights. Along the side, the similarity to the Q8 is more noticeable, although the surfaces of the panels are smooth (similar to an iX3), and around the back the design is relatively clean and similar in look & feel to the front end. 

Step inside, and it’s a similar story to the exterior - the design is totally different to what you would find in a German-built Audi. The main feature you’ll notice is a long screen that stretches across the entire dash, with a passenger screen also built into it. videos.title: DRAMATIC Finish | 2026 Danish Golf Championship
videos.summary_source_text:
DRAMATIC Finish | 2026 Danish Golf Championship Relive the final round drama in the Back 9 on Sunday, presented by Nexo, as Jeff Winther secured victory at his home Open.

This win marks Jeff Winther’s second DP World Tour title in four years, making him only the second Danish player to win the Danish Golf Championship, following Rasmus Højgaard in 2023.

► SUBSCRIBE: http://et.golf/Subscribe 

The DP World Tour returns to action after a three-week break with the penultimate event of the Closing Swing at the Danish Golf Championship. Great Northern will host its first DP World Tour event this week, following in the footsteps of Himmerland, Silkeborg Ry Golf Club, Lübker Golf Resort and Furesø Golf Klub in staging this event. The course is the passion project of Thomas Kirk Kristiansen, a fourth-generation member of the family behind the Lego Group. This event has long been renowned for its bumper crowds and the home fans will have plenty of local talent to cheer for this week. 2023 winner Rasmus Højgaard and fellow Ryder Cupper Thorbjørn Olesen are in action, as is rising star and reigning Australian Open champion Rasmus Neergaard-Petersen. Jacob Skov Olesen is looking to continue his rise, while DP World Tour winners Jeff Winther, Niklas Nørgaard and Lucas Bjerregaard are also in action.

Welcome to the Official YouTube channel of the DP World Tour. Every week you can find extended tournament highlights and individual player highlights from the likes of Rory McIlroy, Justin Rose and Tommy Fleetwood. This is also the home of the 14 Club Challenge, Little Interviews, Fastest Hole and many more challenges, pranks and world record attempts featuring the biggest golfers in the world.

2 oz (60 g) sugar-free dark chocolate.
1 cup (240 ml) milk of your choice. I used almond milk.
⅓ cup (30 g) unsweetened cocoa powder.
